senses.def: to have something and not give it back
senses.ex: You can keep the book, I don't need it.
senses.exPt: Pode ficar com o livro, eu não preciso dele.

senses.def: to continue doing something
senses.ex: Keep walking until you see the bank.
senses.exPt: Continue andando até ver o banco.

senses.def: to make something stay in the same state
senses.ex: Please keep the door closed.
senses.exPt: Por favor, mantenha a porta fechada.

senses.def: to put or store something in a particular place
senses.ex: Where do you keep the plates?
senses.exPt: Onde você guarda os pratos?

senses.def: a container used for boiling water
senses.ex: I'll put the kettle on and make some tea.
senses.exPt: Vou ligar a chaleira e fazer um chá.

senses.def: a piece of metal you use to open a lock
senses.ex: I can't find my car keys anywhere.
senses.exPt: Não acho as chaves do carro em lugar nenhum.

senses.def: very important
senses.ex: Exercise is a key part of a healthy life.
senses.exPt: O exercício é parte fundamental de uma vida saudável.

senses.def: a button on a keyboard
senses.ex: Press any key to start the game.
senses.exPt: Aperte qualquer tecla para começar o jogo.

senses.def: the set of keys on a computer or musical instrument
senses.ex: I spilled coffee on my keyboard this morning.
senses.exPt: Derramei café no meu teclado hoje de manhã.

senses.def: to hit something with your foot
senses.ex: He kicked the ball into the goal.
senses.exPt: Ele chutou a bola para dentro do gol.

senses.def: a hit with your foot
senses.ex: He gave the ball a hard kick.
senses.exPt: Ele deu um chute forte na bola.

senses.def: a child
senses.ex: The kids are playing in the park.
senses.exPt: As crianças estão brincando no parque.

senses.def: someone's son or daughter
senses.ex: How many kids do you have?
senses.exPt: Quantos filhos você tem?

senses.def: to say something that is not true, as a joke
senses.ex: Don't worry, I'm only kidding!
senses.exPt: Relaxa, só estou brincando!

senses.def: to make someone or something die
senses.ex: Too much sun can kill your plants.
senses.exPt: Sol demais pode matar suas plantas.

senses.def: a person or thing that kills
senses.ex: The police finally caught the killer.
senses.exPt: A polícia finalmente prendeu o assassino.

senses.def: an act of killing someone
senses.ex: The police are investigating the killing of a young man.
senses.exPt: A polícia está investigando o assassinato de um jovem.

senses.def: a kilogram; a unit for measuring weight
senses.ex: I bought two kilos of potatoes at the market.
senses.exPt: Comprei dois quilos de batata na feira.

senses.def: a unit for measuring weight; there are 1,000 grams in it
senses.ex: The baby weighed three kilograms when she was born.
senses.exPt: A bebê pesava três quilos quando nasceu.

senses.def: a unit for measuring distance, equal to 1,000 meters
senses.ex: The beach is about five kilometers from here.
senses.exPt: A praia fica a uns cinco quilômetros daqui.

senses.def: a group of things that are similar
senses.ex: What kind of music do you like?
senses.exPt: De que tipo de música você gosta?

senses.def: friendly and nice to other people
senses.ex: She is always kind to everyone at school.
senses.exPt: Ela é sempre gentil com todo mundo na escola.

senses.def: in a kind and helpful way
senses.ex: My neighbour kindly offered to help me with my bags.
senses.exPt: Meu vizinho gentilmente se ofereceu para me ajudar com as malas.

senses.def: kind, friendly and caring
senses.ex: A kindly old woman helped me find the way.
senses.exPt: Uma senhora bondosa me ajudou a encontrar o caminho.

senses.def: the quality of being kind and helpful
senses.ex: Thank you for your kindness during my stay.
senses.exPt: Obrigado pela sua gentileza durante a minha estadia.

senses.def: a man who rules a country because of his family
senses.ex: The king lived in a big castle.
senses.exPt: O rei morava num castelo grande.

senses.def: a country ruled by a king or queen
senses.ex: The story is about a small kingdom by the sea.
senses.exPt: A história é sobre um pequeno reino à beira-mar.

senses.def: a touch with your lips to show love or say hello
senses.ex: She gave her son a kiss on the cheek.
senses.exPt: Ela deu um beijo no rosto do filho.

senses.def: a set of things you need for a particular activity
senses.ex: Every car should have a first aid kit.
senses.exPt: Todo carro deveria ter um kit de primeiros socorros.

senses.def: the clothes a sports team wears
senses.ex: The team has a new kit this season.
senses.exPt: O time tem um uniforme novo nesta temporada.

senses.def: the room where you cook food
senses.ex: Mom is making dinner in the kitchen.
senses.exPt: A mãe está fazendo o jantar na cozinha.

senses.def: a light toy that flies in the wind at the end of a long string
senses.ex: The children are flying a kite in the park.
senses.exPt: As crianças estão soltando pipa no parque.

senses.def: a young cat
senses.ex: Our cat had four kittens last week.
senses.exPt: Nossa gata teve quatro gatinhos semana passada.

senses.def: the joint in the middle of your leg where it bends
senses.ex: I hurt my knee playing football.
senses.exPt: Machuquei o joelho jogando futebol.

senses.def: a tool with a sharp blade for cutting
senses.ex: Be careful, that knife is very sharp.
senses.exPt: Cuidado, essa faca está muito afiada.

senses.def: to make clothes from wool using two long needles
senses.ex: My grandmother knitted me a scarf for my birthday.
senses.exPt: Minha avó tricotou um cachecol para mim de aniversário.

senses.def: to hit a door with your hand so people know you are there
senses.ex: Please knock before you come in.
senses.exPt: Por favor, bata antes de entrar.

senses.def: the sound of someone hitting a door to be let in
senses.ex: We heard a loud knock at the door.
senses.exPt: Ouvimos uma batida forte na porta.

senses.def: to have information about something
senses.ex: I don't know his phone number.
senses.exPt: Eu não sei o número de telefone dele.

senses.def: to be familiar with a person or place
senses.ex: Do you know my sister?
senses.exPt: Você conhece a minha irmã?

senses.def: information and understanding that you have
senses.ex: She has a good knowledge of history.
senses.exPt: Ela tem um bom conhecimento de história.
